origin: Codex 0.142.5-style client (an SDK client) that continues a response by previous_response_id, for three turns: derived from the capture; the relay fails the first and the native tier answers, and the next turns, which continue the response, go to the native tier at once (the relay is not asked). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
